paragraphs: ATAC describes itself as a firm of aviation analysis experts. Its staff is presented as a deep bench of data analysis and subject matter experts in aviation and aerospace. The site says the company has been supporting government clients for over 45 years. International air navigation service providers are named among the audiences it serves.

The work draws on a stated deep understanding of the dynamics and nuances of air traffic management. Stated aims include increasing safety and efficiency and reducing environmental impacts. Analysis relies on tools the page names as PDARS and Simmod PRO. The company claims access to aviation data dating back to the 1990s.

It also says it is actively involved in advancing the future of aviation through a number of R&D projects. The page offers to respond to a client's particular needs with agility and flexibility. The main office is in Santa Clara, California. A Washington, DC metro area office and a San Diego office are also listed.

quote.text: We turn data into relevant information to help guide and support your decision making.
